The '''Bid Party''' was an event hosted by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Parco Ein]] at the [[Verkuylian Imperial Governor's Hall]] on [[Verkuyl]]. The event was for the purpose of entertaining bids on the building of a new [[Alazhi/Legends|alazhi]] [[Refinery/Legends|refinery]]. During the event, the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] infiltrated the Governor's Hall with two agents&mdash;[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Cobb Vartos]] and [[Selby Jarrad]]&mdash;posing as employees for [[GalFactorial]].<ref name="COI" />
